descriptions.d28d_worm_take_damage_80148ef0: Applies a worm's pending damage: returns for an inactive, dead or special-animation worm. Damage reaching the hit points clears them, marks the worm dying, logs 'Worm Waiting To Die' and posts a target message. Positive smaller damage posts an int message, negated when the active worm is on the same team; the value is then subtracted, and a moving or grounded hit worm gets state 11. Then clears the pending value, updates the health bar and position label, posts two messages, logs 'Worm Taking Damage' and calls 0x801506f8.
